aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:861.title: Sr Software Engineer II - Fullstack - AXS
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:861.description: AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today. We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment. AXS is seeking a Sr. Software Engineer II - Full Stack to contribute to the design and development of core ticketing platforms. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives in a complex enterprise environment and is comfortable working across modern web technologies, services, APIs, and integrations in support of high-demand, global use cases. In this role, you will build and scale consumer-facing and B2B web applications, with ownership across front-end experiences, back-end services, and data integrations. You will partner closely with product, design, and engineering teams to deliver reliable, high-quality web experiences while helping shape technical decisions and improve the platform over time. As a senior individual contributor, you will contribute hands-on to implementation while also influencing architecture, guiding technical direction within your team, and helping drive alignment between engineering efforts and business goals. What You’ll Be Doing Act as a deep domain expert and go-to engineer in a critical area of the platform. Lead technically complex initiatives from design through delivery, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance. Design cross-team solutions and influence architecture and technical direction across the organization. Own features and systems end-to-end, including technical design, implementation, testing, and production support. Build and evolve scalable, maintainable, and high-performing web experiences for global ticketing platforms. Partner closely with Product, Design, and engineering stakeholders to deliver intuitive, accessible, and responsive customer-facing applications. Apply full-stack engineering best practices across service design, API contracts, component architecture, performance optimization, accessibility, testing, and maintainability. Build scalable modules for internal applications and external partners. Create and evolve services and APIs that power mission-critical infrastructure. Proactively identify and implement improvements in performance, stability, maintainability, process, and tooling. Participate in design and code reviews to ensure best practices and high-quality code. Collaborate effectively with architects, engineers, business analysts, product managers, and project managers to deliver innovative solutions. Mentor and guide engineers across multiple teams, contributing to technical growth and engineering excellence. Work with third parties and security stakeholders as needed to deliver integrated and secure solutions. What to Bring 6+ years of professional software development experience. Strong experience with web technologies, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Experience with modern frameworks and interfaces such as ReactJS or NextJS. Proficiency in C# and .NET Core, including its ecosystem. Solid technical foundation in building Single Page Applications and modern full-stack web applications. Experience designing and operating distributed, high-throughput, low-latency services and RESTful APIs at scale. Experience working with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL. Excellent

campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:0fe6fb2c-71d5-.title: Partnership Sales Lead- PE/VC
campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:0fe6fb2c-71d5-.description: We’re looking for a Partner Manager focused on Private Equity and Venture Capital partnerships to help grow Campfire through investor ecosystems. In this role, you will work directly with VC and PE firms and their portfolio companies to drive introductions, build relationships, and create pipeline for the sales team. This is a hands-on execution role where success comes from consistent partner engagement, follow-through, and strong collaboration with Sales and Marketing. This is a great role for someone who enjoys building relationships, running partner programs, and driving measurable pipeline through partnerships. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Build relationships with VC and Private Equity firms - Drive warm introductions to portfolio companies - Manage day-to-day partner communication and engagement - Run portfolio outreach programs and partner campaigns - Coordinate events, founder sessions, and partner enablement - Track partner-sourced pipeline and introductions - Work closely with Sales to convert partner-referred opportunities - Maintain partner activity and reporting in CRM - Help improve and operationalize the partner playbook WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 4–8 years of experience in Private Equity, Venture capital, Partnerships, sales, business development, or ecosystem roles - Strong relationship management and follow-through - Comfortable working with investors, founders, and operators - Highly organized and execution-focused - Ability to manage multiple partners and initiatives at once - Strong communication and collaboration skills - Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment NICE TO HAVE - Experience working with VC firms, PE firms, or portfolio companies - Experience in B2B SaaS partnerships or sales - Familiarity with CRM tools and pipeline tracking Existing network in the investor ecosystem

cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:5814d9e4-3f53-41.description: ABOUT: Our platform combines development and management expertise to operate seamlessly across the full real estate lifecycle, from initial investment through ongoing operations. This end-to-end approach allows us to generate sustained value for the communities we support. Our success is driven by our people. We’re committed to delivering meaningful value for tenants and stakeholders by partnering with top talent across the industry. If you’re looking to do impactful work alongside a high-performing team, we invite you to join us.

databricksventures-replit-com:ashbyhq:b2.description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. ABOUT THE ROLE Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. As we scale to support millions of developers and enterprise organizations, maintaining a robust, transparent, and technically sound Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program is critical. We are looking for a GRC Engineer to serve as a key technical contributor for our compliance and risk management ecosystem. You will architect the systems and processes that automate trust, partnering deeply across the organization. We need a pragmatic operator who understands that GRC exists to enable the business—balancing rigorous standards with the velocity of a high-growth startup. WHAT YOU'LL DO Technical Excellence & Architecture - Technical Depth: Act as a technical subject matter expert for the GRC team. You will drive quality, technical depth, and operational efficiency in our security controls. - Program Architecture: Own the technical vision for Replit’s GRC program, moving the team from manual workflows toward "Compliance-as-Code" and automated evidence collection. - Thought Leadership: Champion a culture of security and privacy across the company, educating teams on why controls exist rather than just enforcing them. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Engineering & Architecture: Partner with Architects and Engineering Leads to "bake in" compliance requirements early in the design phase. You will translate complex technical implementations into narratives that satisfy frameworks without slowing down development. - Legal & Privacy: Work closely with Legal Counsel to interpret and implement requirements for Privacy (GDPR, CCPA) and emerging AI-specific regulations (e.g., EU AI Act). - Sales & GTM: Enable the Sales team by managing the Customer Trust Center and handling complex security questionnaires. You will serve as a subject matter expert in customer calls to build confidence with enterprise prospects. - Auditor Relationships: Own and cultivate the primary relationship with external auditors. You will serve as the bridge between auditors and internal teams, ensuring requests are reasonable, clear, and relevant to our tech stack. Risk Management & Strategic Compliance - Risk Register Operator: You will operate the Cybersecurity Risk Register. You will be responsible for identifying, quantifying, and tracking risks, distinguishing between theoretical compliance gaps and meaningful business risks. - Framework Evolution: Manage and evolve our compliance posture across SOC 2, ISO 27001, and prepare the organization for future certifications in regulated markets (e.g., FedRAMP, ITAR, PCI, HIPAA). - Pragmatic Governance: Apply judgment to operate in "gray areas" when appropriate. You will prioritize issues that represent real security or business risk over "compliance theater." Automation & Efficiency - Control Automation: Drive the shift from manual evidence collection to continuous monitoring. You will identify opportunities to automate audit work, ensuring GRC scales with the business. - Third-Party Risk: Architect a scalable framework for assessing third-party vendors and AI model providers, ensuring our supply chain remains secure without creating administrative bottlenecks. REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE - 8+ years of experience in GRC or Information Security - Technical Fluency: Ability to speak the language of engineering, cloud (GCP/AWS), and security architecture. You can anticipate how architectural decisions impact risk and compliance. - Regulatory Breadth: Deep experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, HIPPA, and Privacy laws. - Collaborative Communication: Strong ability to explain risk and tradeoffs to technical (Engineers), legal, and commercial

fincentify-fincentify:ashbyhq:d80c9e85-c.title: Accountant & US Tax Manager
fincentify-fincentify:ashbyhq:d80c9e85-c.description: Who are we? The Company is a client-focused CPA firm serving individuals, businesses, and nonprofit organizations across a wide range of industries. We are currently seeking a well-rounded, detail-oriented, and proactive professional to step into a hybrid role encompassing accounting, tax preparation & review, and client communication management for US based clients. About the role This role works exclusively with U.S. based clients, serving clients under U.S. GAAP and the U.S. federal and state tax framework. Reporting to the firm's owner, this position plays a central role in ensuring efficient internal operations, exceptional client service, and accurate financial reporting. What you'll do Accounting (full-cycle bookkeeping & reconciliation) - Manage full-cycle bookkeeping and account reconciliations for monthly, quarterly, and semiannual clients across a wide range of industries. - Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations, ensuring financial records are accurate and up to date. - Investigate discrepancies, correct coding errors, prepare and post journal entries and adjusting entries in compliance with US GAAP. - Ensure timely and accurate filing of sales tax returns, business entity reports, and other required filings. - Provide support during external audits, including compiling documentation, reconciling accounts, and resolving auditor questions. - Review client general ledger data to identify irregularities and implement corrective adjustments for clean financials. - Maintain organized digital records of all client financials, reports, and internal communications to ensure audit readiness and operational transparency. Tax preparation, review & workflow management - Prepare, review, and present accurate consolidated and entity-level financial statements and management reporting packages - Prepare complex tax returns for businesses (1120, 1120S, 1065) and individuals, including multi-state filings, self-employment income, and rental property activity - Ensure timely and accurate filing of sales tax returns, business entity reports, and other required filings - Review returns prepared by staff, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and completeness before final submission - Coordinate internal tax workflow, track return statuses, and assign preparation tasks to ensure timely progress across all client accounts - Collaborate directly with the firm's owner to identify applicable deductions and credits and gather supporting documentation from clients - Maintain strong knowledge of current federal and state tax laws and proactively adjust practices to ensure compliance and tax optimization - Deliver clear analysis of business performance, unit economics, margins, and portfolio trends across operations - Lead budgeting, forecasting, rolling re-forecasts, and cash-flow planning, with variance analysis against plan to support short- and long-term decision-making Client communication & office coordination - Serve as the primary point of contact for clients across all service areas, managing inbound calls, emails, and messages in a prompt and professional manner - Address client questions regarding tax documents, financial reports, account reconciliations, and - payment processing, escalating matters to the owner when appropriate - Provide support during external audits, including compiling documentation, reconciling accounts and resolving auditor questions - Maintain internal workflows to support daily office operations, including document routing, data requests, and CRM upkeep - Represent the firm's values of integrity, reliability, and exceptional service in every client interaction What we're looking for - This position serves U.S. clients exclusively — U.S. tax experience and U.S. GAAP experience are strongly preferred - Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field (or equivalent experience) - 3+ years of experience in public accounting, bookkeeping, and/or tax preparation - Strong proficiency in Quic

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:40da5a82-9f7.description: Wing is on the exciting mission of redefining the future of work for companies across the world. We are looking to be the one-stop shop for companies that are looking to build world-class teams & place their operations on autopilot. The Role The Recruitment Specialist will serve on the Talent Acquisition Team to conduct full-cycle recruitment specifically to source, interview and assess candidates across different industries and roles for Wing. They will work with the talent acquisition team to appropriately match top talent with clients needing assistance in their team.
responsibilities: Source candidates through different channels such as job boards, sourcing platforms, social media, and the like
Conducts interviews, screening, and onboarding candidates across different functions by accurately matching high-quality candidates with job descriptions
Manage initial candidate processing by verifying references, and experience, and sending offer letters to ensure that we only hire top-quality applicants

Update the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), with the most up-to-date information regarding candidates, the stage they are in, onboarding statuses, and talent pipelines, including updating account managers, and other key stakeholders
Work with the Sourcing Team and Talent Acquisition Partners to ensure that we are diversifying our strategies to source high-quality candidates in high volumes actively
Debrief candidates on the responsibilities of the job, expectations, workflows, and routines that they should follow
Identify opportunities to improve staffing, talent pipeline management, sourcing, and onboarding
Regularly communicate with stakeholders regarding the progress of recruiting the best talent for the accounts assigned and handled

jobgether-jobgether:lever:1a924928-ae41-.title: Romanian Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1a924928-ae41-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Romanian Voice Actor – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Australia. This freelance opportunity is designed for an experienced Romanian voice professional interested in helping shape the next generation of AI-powered speech technology. You will contribute authentic, high-quality Romanian voice data used to improve the clarity, naturalness, and expressiveness of AI-generated speech. The work combines professional voice performance with speech evaluation, linguistic feedback, and AI training activities. You will record scripted content while assessing AI outputs for pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional accuracy. Your expertise will help refine voice models and evaluation standards for applications spanning accessibility, education, entertainment, and more. The project offers a flexible remote environment suited to experienced contractors with a professional recording setup. It is an opportunity to apply your voice expertise to emerging AI technologies while directly influencing how machines communicate in Romanian. Record scripted material in Romanian with clear pronunciation, natural delivery, consistent pacing, and appropriate emotional expression. Produce high-quality voice recordings suitable for AI training and speech-model development. Evaluate AI-generated speech for linguistic accuracy, pronunciation, naturalness, tone, pacing, and expressiveness. Identify and annotate errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated outputs and provide clear, actionable feedback. Assess regional and linguistic variations in Romanian to help improve the authenticity and robustness of voice models. Collaborate with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation methodologies, annotation practices, and voice-design guidelines. Apply professional voice-acting expertise to distinguish natural human speech from awkward, inaccurate, or unnatural AI-generated responses. Maintain consistent recording quality and follow technical, linguistic, and project-specific guidelines throughout assignments. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in Romanian voice acting, dubbing, narration, or a closely related performance discipline. Native-level or highly proficient Romanian language skills with excellent pronunciation and linguistic accuracy. Strong vocal control, including the ability to adjust tone, pacing, emphasis, emotion, and delivery according to different scripts and contexts. Excellent listening and evaluation skills, with the ability to identify subtle pronunciation, fluency, and naturalness issues. Strong attention to detail and the ability to provide precise, constructive feedback. Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to follow detailed project guidelines. Experience with linguistic annotation, voice coaching, AI training, speech evaluation, or similar work is a plus. Access to a reliable computer, stable internet connection, high-quality microphone, and quiet recording environment. Ability to work independently and consistently as a remote freelance contractor. Curiosity about AI and an interest in contributing professional expertise to emerging speech technologies. Benefits Freelance contract with fully remote work. Flexible project-based working environment. Opportunity to contribute directly to the development and improvement of AI speech technology. Pay ranging from US$6 to US$65 per hour , with the final rate determined by experience, expertise, and geographic location. Opportunity to apply professional Romanian voice expertise to large-scale AI training projects. Exposure to cutting-edge AI tools, speech technologies, and evaluation methodologies. Contractor flexibility, with the understanding that equipment, internet, health insurance, PTO, and other employee-sponsored benefits are not provided. Contractors are responsible for supplying their own secu

Our partner is looking for a Portuguese Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Portugal. This opportunity is designed for an experienced Portuguese voice professional interested in helping shape the next generation of AI-powered speech technologies. You will contribute your voice expertise to training data that helps AI systems communicate with greater clarity, accuracy, and naturalness. The role combines professional voice performance with speech evaluation, linguistic annotation, and AI model feedback. You will record scripted Portuguese content and assess AI-generated speech for pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional authenticity. Your insights will help improve voice models used across areas such as education, entertainment, accessibility, and digital communication. You’ll work with advanced AI tools while applying your professional judgment and attention to linguistic detail. This is a flexible freelance opportunity for a skilled Portuguese voice actor looking to make a meaningful contribution to AI development. Record high-quality scripted speech samples in Portuguese for use in AI training and voice model development. Evaluate AI-generated speech for linguistic accuracy, pronunciation, naturalness, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional variation. Identify, annotate, and clearly document errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated voice outputs. msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? A Tour Guide will create the positive impression of our building s , our events, our operation and the overall “Madison Square Garden Experience.” They will conduct a 60-minute behind-the-scenes walking tour of Radio City with the goal of giving guests a world-class experience. This position is also responsible for general order and safety of the visitors along the predetermined route as well as greeting and checking in guests at the beginning of each tour. What will you do? Conduct daily public tours of Radio City Music Hall in an orderly and safe fashion. Memorize a 20-25 page script and present in a clear, concise, informative and entertaining manner Memorize multiple tour routes and become familiar with all front of house and back of house areas of the venue s Assist fellow Tour Guides with large groups from time to time. Secure, return, and observe proper use of equipment such as radios, keys, uniform , locker room, props and technology during tours. Ability to interact and work cordially alongside other departments. Must keep abreast of all company and team news, as well as coming events. Participate in special projects and performs other duties as assigned. Must conduct a minimum of 3-4 tours per day. Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site. What do you need to succeed? Experience in a tour-related or entertainment industry desired . Strong public speaking and communication skills required with a focus on customer service. Recommended background would include, but not limited to, previous employment as a Tour Guide or experience in the theater, performing arts, or communications. Must possess excellent memorization and time management skills with the ability to articulate and inject energy and enthusiasm into presentation. Ability to adapt to requests and changes to the tour script, route and assignment on short notice. Good organizational skills to check in groups and collect tickets as necessary. Special Requirements General physical requirements such as lifting 25 lbs., standing for long periods , walking long distances, bending and constant motion is often required . Must be able to traverse steps , walk and stand long periods of time . Proficiency in a second language is not required , but nice to have. Must be available 4 days a week including Sundays and holidays as needed. #LI-Onsite Hourly Pay Range $24 — $24 USD At MSG, we recognize the importance of upskilling employees’ talents and strengths so they can drive their careers forward. We are proud to offer a robust set of tools and resources to help employees understand their interests and purpose, harness their talents and obtain the skills they need to reach the next step in their careers. Growth and longevity for our employees are top priorities here. We value diversity and are looking for extraordinary employees of all backgrounds! southparkcommons-koah-labs:ashbyhq:197c9.description: Who We Are Koah Labs is building the ad network to power the next generation of AI-native products. Our mission is to help publishers monetize and help advertisers reach the right audience — without compromising speed, UX, or privacy. We’re a small, tight-knit team in San Francisco with backgrounds at X, Apple, Meta and early-stage startups. We’ve raised from top investors and are growing fast with real traction on both the publisher and advertiser sides of the marketplace. Working at Koah means joining at the ground floor: you’ll ship code that shapes the company and the ecosystem we’re building. We move quickly, operate with high trust, and care deeply about craft. Our Stack - Infra: Terraform, AWS, LGTM (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir), Tailscale, Cloudflare - Data: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Kafka, Python - Core Application: Ruby on Rails, React, TypeScript - SDKs: iOS, Android, Web, Flutter, React Native In this role, you will: - Help shape core ad experiences and shape how people see ads across our ad network - Tackle meaningful challenges with increasing autonomy, crafting code that millions of users will experience - Take ownership of projects that matter, make critical technical decisions, and contribute your unique perspective to our product vision. - Work alongside passionate experts across design, product, and data to create the advertising experience in this new era You might thrive in this role if you: - Enjoy proactively communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders - Are comfortable working across the stack, tackling new tasks out of your comfort zone, and can handle ambiguity - Work well in-person and enjoy fast feedback loops - Enjoy breaking down problems and testing your hypotheses - Get excited about end-to-end ownership within high agency environments

southparkcommons-sparrow:ashbyhq:c151416.title: GTM Partnerships
southparkcommons-sparrow:ashbyhq:c151416.description: ABOUT US Sparrow is the first high-tech, high-touch employee leave management solution. Our mission is to make it simple for companies to provide their employees with all kinds of leave (i.e. family, medical, etc.). Currently, the leave management process is painful and inefficient for everyone. Company leaders struggle to keep up with regulations and processes that change frequently, and the employees going on leave are overwhelmed by bureaucracy at an exceptionally important juncture in their career. Sparrow transforms this ordinarily tedious, error-prone, complex to remain compliant, and time-consuming process into a 30-minute end-to-end experience saving teams time (20 - 40 hours per leave) and money (up to $30K per leave). Sparrow is headquartered in San Francisco but all employees work remotely across the country. Sparrow is a diverse, highly talented, and supportive team. Together, we are hardworking, collaborative, smart, and humble—after all, we’re solving real problems. ABOUT THE ROLE In this GTM Partnerships role, you will build and scale Sparrow’s go-to-market motion with our strategic partners, with a focus specifically on HRIS, disability insurance carriers, payroll systems, PEO organizations, and point solution partnerships. This is a highly impactful role responsible for unlocking new partners and strengthening existing partnerships, ultimately driving pipeline and closed-won revenue. This role requires a strategic, innovative, and execution-oriented leader with experience working with the types of partners described above. You will work closely with our sales, marketing, product, and service teams to develop innovative GTM partnership strategies, improve integrations and shared service models, and ensure our strategic relationships in the market deliver exceptional outcomes for shared clients and their employees. GTM STRATEGY & EXECUTION - Execute Sparrow's GTM strategy for our partners, such as HRIS systems, disability insurance carriers, payroll systems, PEO organizations, and point solution partnerships. - Identify and secure new partnerships to expand Sparrow's reach and market presence. - Operationalize and deepen our existing partnerships to ensure we are capitalizing on GTM momentum. - Be the face of these partnerships internally, working closely with our internal service, operations, and engineering teams as they scope work, maintain timelines, and drive initiatives to completion. - Negotiate preferred partnerships and build joint GTM initiatives, co-selling frameworks, and other initiatives and partnerships that differentiate Sparrow in the market. - Create materials, training, processes and tools to position Sparrow effectively within partner organizations. PIPELINE & REVENUE GROWTH - Own pipeline generation, closed-won, and retention business through net-new and existing partnerships. - Partner closely with Sales to activate and manage partner-sourced opportunities. - Track and optimize performance metrics across partnerships to ensure strong ROI and growth. RELATIONSHIP & PARTNERSHIP MANAGEMENT - Build and maintain deep relationships with key stakeholders across all partners. - Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic partnerships, coordinating with internal technical and service teams as they build and support shared customers. - Build the foundation for a scalable partnerships function — processes, playbooks, and future team growth. ABOUT YOU - 5-7+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, or business development. - Direct experience working with insurance carriers, point solutions, and/or HRIS ecosystems to build or scale partnership programs in a high-growth environment. - Deep understanding of the HR tech and/or insurance carrier ecosystem. - Strong ability to build and manage partner relationships. - Strategic thinker who can also operate hands-on to build from the ground up. - Experience working cross-functionally with technical, product, and service teams and leading h

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.title: Assistant Manager
summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek a dedicated individual that is looking to advance their leadership opportunity. This individual must possess a high drive to win while maintaining the integrity to do the right thing. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You will manage a team of highly trained, optimistic Advisors, Operators, and Attendants to provide exceptional guest service in a fun, interactive atmosphere. We need an enthusiastic leader that has experience in management, and a willingness to learn the car wash industry. Location: Russell Speeders Car Wash (Douglas County, NE) 15505 Spaulding Plaza, Omaha, NE 68116
